meta.description: Planner modules in preparation: grades and report cards, student life, families, admissions, fees and payments, and more. None is available yet.

entete.accroche: These modules are in preparation. None is available yet, and no date is announced.

cartes.texte: Grade entry and report cards, with LMD credits.
Absences, discipline, elective choices and activities.
An account for parents, for one or several children, and meetings with teachers.
Applications through to enrolment, with nothing typed twice.
School bus routes and boarding rooms.
Student internships, and staying in touch with alumni.
Certificates with a code anyone can check.
The school's key figures, for its leaders.
Planner in Arabic, alongside French and English.
The mobile app, usable without a connection.
School data, exported to your country's national platform. In Morocco, Massar is one example.
